The 4 apps that I actually use for photography ☕︎
 
Lightroom is where 99% of my editing happens, from exposure to my full cinematic grade.
 
TouchRetouch is for fast cleanups on the go, way quicker than opening Lightroom for a tiny fix.
 
Alpenglow tells me exactly where and when the sun will rise or set, so I’m in the right spot at the right time.
 
SCRL is how I make those satisfying horizontal swipes for my carousels.
 
None of these are groundbreaking on their own, but together they cover planning, shooting, editing and posting. Save this if you’re building your own kit.

📌 Save this Mardin itinerary for your trip to Türkiye 🇹🇷🤎

✨ TOP THINGS TO SEE
🏘️ Mardin Old Town – Explore the beautiful stone streets
🏛️ Zinciriye Medresesi – Incredible views over the city
🕌 Kasimiye Medresesi – Stunning architecture and history
⛪ Ulu Cami – Mardin’s historic Great Mosque
🕯️ Kırklar Church – Discover the city’s Syriac heritage
🏰 Old PTT Building – Admire beautiful stone architecture
🛍️ Old Mardin bazaars – Wander through traditional markets
✝️ Deyrulzafaran Monastery – Discover the history of the Syriac community
🙏 Mor Gabriel Monastery – Visit an ancient monastery near Midyat
🏺 Dara Ancient City – Explore ancient ruins and an impressive underground cistern
📜 Mardin Museum – Learn more about the city’s history

🌅 BEST ROOFTOPS
☕ Matera – Climb up for amazing views over the old city
🍹 Seyr-i Merdin Terrace – Enjoy beautiful views from the heart of the Old Town

🏨 WHERE TO STAY
🛏️ Izala Hotel – Stay in a traditional stone building in the Old Town

🍽️ WHERE TO EAT
🥘 Cercis Murat Konagi – Try local cuisine with a gourmet touch
💃 Hamdani Restaurant – Enjoy dinner with live music and performances
🌇 Kasr-i Bagdadi – Savour local food with beautiful views

🤎 Don’t rush your visit. Get lost in the narrow streets, enjoy the rooftops at sunset and take time to meet the incredibly welcoming locals

✈️ The easiest way to get to Mardin is to fly directly from Istanbul with @turkishairlines to Mardin with a flight time of around 2 hours

Discover more hidden gems in Türkiye and follow @goturkiye on Instagram for more travel inspiration

Eleuthería - What does it mean to be free when you don’t know what you’re trying to escape? 

Perhaps we keep moving because we’re afraid of what we might find in the stillness. We leave places, chase new beginnings, and hope along the way somewhere, something inside us will finally settle. But no matter how far we go, we carry ourselves with us. Maybe freedom isn’t about finding somewhere else to be, but learning that we don’t always have to run from where we are.
